subject.title: fix(channels): bound draft-stream flush loop to prevent runaway sends

question: May the exported `DraftStreamLoop.flush()` resolve after 20 sends while pending text remains scheduled for later delivery?
rationale: The new behavior solves the runaway loop but changes an exported plugin SDK method from an apparent drain barrier into a bounded batch operation, and repository history does not establish that external callers tolerate that semantic change.

options.title: Preserve drain semantics
options.body: Separate the bounded timer-driven worker from explicit `flush()` completion so scheduled updates yield without letting an awaited flush return with pending text.

options.title: Approve bounded flush
options.body: Accept the new completion semantics, document them as the SDK contract, and add compatibility tests proving stop/finalize callers cannot cancel pending delivery.

options.title: Pause for API redesign
options.body: Hold the PR until the shared loop exposes separate bounded-batch and drain-until-idle operations with unambiguous names.

recommendation.title: Preserve drain semantics
recommendation.body: Separate the bounded timer-driven worker from explicit `flush()` completion so scheduled updates yield without letting an awaited flush return with pending text.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cross-channel streaming work makes this person the strongest available router for the shared lifecycle contract.
